chapter: Closing: recent career, family and travel
title: Duke Ellington's hotel bathroom light tip
summary: Dance relates Duke's advice to leave the bathroom light on.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Another thing, I remember when I went on tour with Duke, I said to him one night... He said, "What city are we in?" I said, "I don't know." I really didn't know. Then we were talking, and I said, "Well, here you sleep in a different hotel every night; if you have to get up, how do

you know where the john is?" And he said, "Stanley, you really are... You're not very experienced." He said, "You always leave the light on in the john with the door just ajar." And that's true, because I used to wake up, and you know, I didn't know where the light was, the switch...
